# Guest checkout (issue #142)

## Why
Shoppers without an account leave at the login wall. Issue #142 counts the orders lost there.

## What
- A shopper pays without an account, with an email address for the receipt.
- The order shows up in the shop's order list like any other.

## Not this
- No account is created behind the shopper's back. No saved cards.

## Success
- A guest order completes in one pass through checkout, and the receipt arrives by email.
